TC-21/S18.title: Handoff in both contexts: same four sections, empty stays empty, in-app delivery of the edited text with a record on both sides
TC-21/S18.detail: Local 8b4be94a (ho-s03a / ho-s03b, no model): both contexts show the same four section headings in the same order, only their own context's patients; edited text delivered exactly; Sent / Received rows with names and server time on both sides; no mailto anywhere. Dev 8b4be94a (live Haiku, ho-s15): sparse patient (no tasks) and sparse resident get empty Discharge Barriers / Pending Results (nothing invented in the sections). Note: the sparse Hospital intro narrates 'Vitals and recent clinical course not documented.' (TC-08 S15).
